en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing an Indigenous woman in traditional dress smiling while baking bread in an outdoor adobe beehive oven (horno). She stands holding a long wooden paddle with dough near the oven opening; several loaves rest on a cloth-covered board in the foreground. In the background are scattered low buildings on a dry, open plain. Handwritten or stamped text near the bottom mentions a pueblo.
